title: Calibrate real two-word controls on the actual persistent specimen
statement: A clipped dyadic mixture of the source-B physical words T0 and T3T3 supplies each required local refresh row using one or two native calls and exactly16 fresh selector bits. Uniform pointwise calibration confidence handles correlation with retained old records; it does not promise confidence after arbitrary rare postselection.
